name: Divine Plagues

outcomes.failure: The target is afflicted with divine plague at stage 1.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target is afflicted with divine plague at stage 2.

heightening.text: The divine plague disease gains the virulent trait. The condition value for the clumsy, enfeebled, or stupefied condition is 2 instead of 1.

entries: Your deity sends wracking plagues. The target must attempt a Fortitude save. When you Cast the Spell, decide whether the disease inflicts the clumsy, enfeebled, or stupefied condition.
Stage 1 clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 (1 round)
Stage 2 slowed 1 and clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 (1 round)
Stage 3 clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 and the target can't recover from the condition until they are cured} (1 day)
